The Autoconf `install-sh` file originates from the X Window System’s X11R5 script:

`mit/util/scripts/install.sh`

It was later released in X11R6 as:

`xc/config/util/install.sh`

The X11R6 version carries a 1994 copyright by the X Consortium, while some earlier copies identify a 1991 copyright by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. FSF modifications are stated to be in the public domain.
